newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up at 16-month high vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up at 16-month high vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at another 16-month high of 8.2970 against the U.S. dollar on Thursday from Wednesday's 8.2975 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, traders said.
The yuan opened up at an intra-day high of 8.2966 and moved steadily around 8.2970 for most of the session, hitting a low of 8.2975 late in trading.
Trading was dull with most done at 8.2970, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan was pulled up by strong pro-yuan sentiment, but seemed to be capped at 8.2970.
"There was some selling above 8.2970 to halt the yuan's rise," said one dealer.
"The yuan is expected to remain strong due to China's increased trade surplus data in 1996," a second dealer said.
Traders expect the yuan to move up slightly on Friday.
The yuan closed down at 7.4000 from 7.3903 against 100 Japanese yen and ended down at an intra-day low of 1.0735 from 1.0729 against the Hong Kong dollar.
